requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting started with Memotto"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memotto is a note-taking app where you can combine text, tables, and images into one."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide will be explained using the examples of Yamanishi from PR and Takanashi from Sales."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "A short note added to a page is called a 'Quick Note'."}, {"id":1, "text": "Yamanashi has left a Quick Note about the meeting's decisions."}, {"id":2, "text": "Yamanashi has put sticky notes on important parts to mark them."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Each page can have up to ten notes."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "For teams to use"}, {"id":1, "text": "Takanashi's sales team first created a workspace."}, {"id":2, "text": "The place that everyone can see within the workspace is called 'Hiroba' (Commons)."}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Anyone can post memos in the Commons."}, {"id":1, "text": "Takanashi shares his sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id":2, "text": "You can invite members to a workspace via email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Invited people will receive a confirmation email."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Once approved by the administrator, you can join immediately."}, {"id":1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed per plaza."}, {"id":2, "text": "Sync and history"}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all devices."}, {"id":1, "text": "You can edit offline, and it will sync as soon as you connect."}, {"id":2, "text": "You can revert to a previous state from the page history."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tsukimisato recovered the text she accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Tips for organization"}, {"id":1, "text": "It is convenient to pin important pages."}, {"id":2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It is easier to find notes in the plaza if you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Kotori-san divides tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The same tag can be used for a single item."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "In searches, you can look for both tags and short notes at the same time."}, {"id":1, "text": "If you can't find it, try broadening your search scope."}]}
